name: Window Magnet
description:
Snaps the edges of a window to the edges of other windows and of the screen while you move or resize it, with a short spring so the snap feels magnetic instead of abrupt.

* Move: both edges of each axis snap to nearby window and screen edges
* Resize: the edges you drag snap too
* Tabs: a tab dragged out of an app window and dropped on the desktop opens its new window where you dropped it

Threshold and every behaviour can be changed in the preferences.
